why: City of Oconto 'City Park Campground Rules' PDF, linked from cityofoconto.com/camping/ (read 2026-11-17): '11. Capacity: 2 tents per site or 1 pop up camper and 1 tent.' The city admits nothing larger than a pop-up, so a 23-ft motorhome is excluded by an explicit agency rule.
name: City Park Campground (Oconto City Park)
flags: Sources read 2026-11-17: city camping page (cityofoconto.com/camping/: 'or "rough it" ... City Park Campground, which is just feet from the stunning Bay of Green Bay', County N, 920-834-7725); City Park Campground Rules PDF (capacity rule above; '$15 per day', pay slips and a pay pole at the entrance; toilet; 'Drive on the main road and park in your site'); City Park Campground Map PDF (2017; 9 numbered sites on a one-way loop off Highway N, 'Camping Site $15 dollars per Night', 'For Reservations Call 834-7706 ... not necessary unless on a holiday weekend').

Contrary listings, not used: Travel Wisconsin lists site types 'Group Sites, RV, Tent, Trailer' (9-site rustic facility); The Dyrt lists 'RV Sites' as a type with no hookups, and its only review (May 2026, 2.0/5) names no rig. Neither outranks the city's explicit capacity rule (curation doc: explicit agency limits drop whatever reviews say).

Esri imagery 2026-11-17 (300 m and 1.2 km frames, rendered): the loop is a small clearing under hardwood canopy WEST of County N, about 50 m across; the bay shore lies ~200 m east beyond County N and the city park's lawns and drives. No rigs visible. Had it been an add, waterfront would have been at most 'coastal walk' (County N is a county highway between; would need a ruling) and likely 'not waterfront'.

Duplicate check: not in the DB by name; nearest entries 3549 Holtwood Campground (the city's other campground, about 4 km NW on the Oconto River) and 3550 North Bay Shore County Park (~13 km NE). Google Maps 'Oconto City Park' (44.85886,-87.85712, 4.4 on 245, phone 920-834-7706) is the whole park, not the campground.

If AWH knows the capacity rule is stale (the PDF was uploaded 2020 but is still the city's linked rules), this becomes a primitive $15/night 9-site local add; nothing current says RVs beyond pop-ups are allowed.
